subject: Site Engineer, Gympie, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I'm applying for the Site Engineer role in Gympie advertised on SEEK, and sending my resume and cover letter to this address as the ad asks.

I'm a civil engineering graduate (BSCE, 2019) who finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia in February 2026. My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020: project-in-charge on a community hall renovation, coordinating 10 to 15 workers a day, then field engineer on subdivision finishing works. The day-to-day was inspections, quality and safety checks, reviewing drawings, tracking procurement and materials, and writing site reports, which lines up with the quality, procurement and documentation side of your role. I haven't worked on sewer projects like your Southside Sewerage stages for Gympie Regional Council, and my Australian experience is the diploma, so I'd be learning your systems and the local standards on the job.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for regional work, and open to discussing relocation to Gympie.

My drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd welcome a phone conversation.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate

letter.subject: Application for Site Engineer, Gympie
paragraphs: I'm applying for the Site Engineer position based in Gympie, advertised on SEEK. A self-performing civil contractor that runs its own quality, safety and environmental system and wants a site engineer who grows into a leader is where I want to start my Australian career, and regional Queensland suits me. I noticed OCE is delivering Stages 9 and 10 of the Southside Sewerage Program for Gympie Regional Council; I have not worked on sewer projects, and that is exactly the work I'd like to learn on.

My site experience is from the Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020. As project-in-charge on a community hall renovation I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day, reviewed structural and architectural drawings, checked the work against them, and carried out inspections, safety checks and quality monitoring. As a field engineer on subdivision finishing works I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. That is the same work your role lists: inspection and test records, client updates, procurement and control, and site documentation.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The coursework covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage design and documentation in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards and Austroads guides, cost estimates and bills of quantities, and risk registers. That is where my knowledge of Australian standards and civil documentation comes from; I have not worked on an Australian site yet.

I use Word, Excel and Outlook. I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, a Working with Children Check, and full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I'm based in Melton, Victoria, available for regional and FIFO work, and open to discussing relocation to Gympie.
My resume is attached and my drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio. I'd be glad to talk by phone and to meet your team in Gympie.
